changes.newText: Filter: A property filter above the table narrows the rows. The Resource Group step filters by Name, Description, Active status, and Public Status; the Domain and Project steps filter by Name and Active status. On managers that do not support combined filter conditions, only Name is offered and one condition can be applied at a time.

changes.newText: Status: Whether the resource group is Active or Inactive.
changes.newHtml: Status: Whether the resource group is Active or Inactive.

changes.newText: Status: Whether the domain is Active or Inactive.

The Active and Inactive buttons above the list choose which resource groups are listed, and the property filter next to them narrows the list by Name, Description, Public, or Default. On managers that do not support combined filter conditions, only one condition can be applied at a time.

On managers that do not support combined filter conditions, only one condition can be applied at a time.

changes.newText: The Default column marks the default resource group. At most one resource group carries the marker, and an agent that registers without a resolvable resource group name falls back to it.

changes.newText: The Active and Inactive buttons above the list choose which projects are listed, and the property filter next to them narrows the list by Name, Domain, Resource Policy, Project ID, Created At, or Modified At. Project ID must be a full UUID, and Created At and Modified At take a date and time.

Project ID must be a full UUID, and Created At and Modified At take a date and time.

changes.newText: The Modified At and Status columns are hidden by default and can be shown using the column-settings gear button (⚙) at the right of the table header. Status shows whether a project is Active or Inactive. Your column choices are persisted per browser across sessions.
